5–10 minutes (plus the time to clear the creatures)
Cross several floors of Edron's {wiki:Hero Cave}, full of heroes, monks, priestesses and dragons, to the last floor, where a box holds a {item:Silver Rune Emblem (Ultimate Healing)}.
Hero Cave entrance, north of Edron
Follow the images floor by floor: the quest is a route through holes and stairs, always heading down.
Bring health potions: there are {creature:Hero|Heroes}, {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks} and {creature:Dragon|Dragons} on the way.
1. Going down through the Hero Cave

Go to the {wiki:Hero Cave} in **Edron**. The entrance is marked in the image. If you're not in Edron, take a boat (tell the harbour captain {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}); you arrive at the Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. From the harbour head **north** to the Hero Cave entrance, north of the city.
When you enter the underground, kill a few {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors} and go to the next hole (see image). Go down.

Kill {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, {creature:Priestess|Priestesses} and {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}. Follow the path in the image and go down the stairs.
Follow the path in the image, killing {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}. Go down the stairs.
Kill the 3 {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and the 2 {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings} and enter the marked hole.
The {creature:Dragon|Dragons} cast area fire: don't let them all gather around you.
Kill one {creature:Hero} and two {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}. Follow the path in the image and go down again.
Kill {creature:Hunter|Hunters}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}. Go down the stairs.
The last floor has 5 {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}. Kill them and open the crate to receive the {item:Silver Rune Emblem (Ultimate Healing)}.
The crate with the Silver Rune Emblem

Go back the same way, following the images in reverse: go up the stairs you came down and use the {item:Rope} on the holes you fell through, up to the Hero Cave entrance. Outside, head **south** to Edron, where {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you by boat to other cities.
Before update 8.6 the reward was an {item:Ultimate Healing Rune} with 3 charges (hence the name *Triple UH Rune Quest*). The overcharged runes were replaced by {wiki:Rune Emblems}.
